name: The Kortz Center Heist
requirement: Own a Mansion (from $11,500,000) with the Art Studio upgrade ($4,700,000)
setups: Infiltration Gear (Staff Key Card, Tactical Equipment, Alpha Mail Disguise or Hazmat Suit)
potentialTake: The first primary painting sold each week pays a large bonus (roughly $1.2-$1.9 million depending on the painting); repeat sales that week drop to around $300,000-$500,000, plus secondary art. Witnesses and damage lower the value.
eliteChallenge: Finish in under 17:00 with over 90% accuracy, minimal value loss and the buyer's requested item secured; $50,000 bonus ($100,000 on Hard).
description: The first major heist in years: Mr. Faber and his fixer Raf De Angelis plan a theft of paintings from the Kortz Center art museum in Pacific Bluffs. Counterfeiter Yong-Rae produces replicas in the Art Studio, and stealthy runs preserve the art's value.

bestApproach.name: Staff Entrance
bestApproach.why: Staff Key Card gives the fastest direct entry and works on any difficulty.

bestChoices.name: Infiltration gear: Staff Key Card
bestChoices.why: Opens the Staff Entrance, the most direct route.

bestChoices.name: Optional prep: Guard Shipments
bestChoices.why: Thins out guards and helps the accuracy target.

bestChoices.name: Getaway: helicopter with Advanced Avionics
bestChoices.why: Stops the auto-pilot crashing on the way to the drop-off.

bestChoices.name: Stay undetected
bestChoices.why: Witnesses and camera evidence lower the art value.

bestChoices.name: Sell the painting, do not display it
bestChoices.why: Displaying it in the Art Studio pays nothing.

bestChoices.name: Solo: avoid requests in Crisp Gallery
bestChoices.why: That area needs two players and blocks the Elite bonus.

payout.note: Primary painting only: Normal repeat sale ~$305k-481k up to Hard first sale of the week (~$2.12M); first weekly sale on Normal ~$1.2M-1.9M. Secondary loot adds ~$220k-320k solo. Repeat setups cost $100k; ~2.4h cooldown. Elite $50k Normal / $100k Hard.

pros: Biggest weekly first-run payout for solo players
cons: Mansion plus Art Studio cost over $16M
Some loot needs a second player
